content: सत्यंकारः .²1 Making true or good, ratification of a contract or bargain. .²2 Earnest money, advance payment, something given in advance as an earnest for the performance of a contract; उपाधत्त सपत्नेषु कृष्णाया गुरुसंनिधौ . भावमानयने सत्याः सत्यंकारमिवान्तकः .. <ls>Ki. 11. 50</ls>. .²3 A promise.
